mapper.select:
SELECT c.*, co.name AS course_name, u.name AS teacher_name FROM class c LEFT JOIN course co ON c.course_id = co.id LEFT JOIN teacher t ON c.teacher_id = t.id LEFT JOIN user u ON t.user_id = u.id
AND co.name LIKE concat('%', #{courseName}, '%')
AND u.name LIKE concat('%', #{teacherName}, '%')
ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO class(course_id, class_name, teacher_id, status, create_time) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{className}, #{teacherId}, 1, NOW())
